services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Summer Day Camps are an educational opportunity for children in the grades K-6th that run during the summer. Each week of camp is themed and involves fun topics taught through hands-on activities and projects. The days are filled with awesome education and fun that will ignite a desire for more and build memories that last. Click our Camp FAQs below to learn more! Step into a world of towering dinosaurs and explore the life-sized exhibits that bring these giants to life. Explore the principles of taste, texture, and nutrition while discovering the science behind what we eat, how food fuels our bodies, and how it works. June 22 - 26: Creature Feature Camp-Wild, Weird, and Wonderful - Limited

services.name: Simply Programs
services.desc: Simply Science and Studies is an educational program that meets once a week for 28 weeks divided among two semesters. This program is for home educated students who are in K-12th grade. Participants can pick individual classes to enroll in or bundle multiple classes on one day for an all-day bundle package. Costs vary depending on your selection of classes and the grade level of the participants. Prices range from $250 for our shortest class to $900 for our all-day Middle and Upper-level S.T.E.A.M. classes. Bundle pricing is available for participants enrolling in all classes on Mondays or Tuesdays. We do have a payment plan available. See registration form for current pricing. An initial
